title: It's All About Covers: Persistent Homology of Cover Refinements
summary: The computational cost of persistent homology is often dominated by the growth of the underlying simplicial filtrations. Many different filtrations exist, each with its own assumptions and trade-offs, but all face some form of this growth which can be exponential in the worst case, as for the Vietoris-Rips. We recast this problem at the level of covers, developing a framework in which filtrations and persistence modules can be constructed, analyzed, and compared through simple relations between covers rather than at the level of simplicial complexes.
